Question: Two bees start at the same spot and fly at the same rate in the following directions. Bee \(A\) travels \(1\) foot north, then \(1\) foot east, then \(1\) foot upwards, and then continues to repeat this pattern. Bee \(B\) travels \(1\) foot south, then \(1\) foot west, and then continues to repeat this pattern. In what directions are the bees traveling when they are exactly \(10\) feet away from each other?
